create_mephisto_project: create a new project in the local mephisto database with a given project name
create_mephisto_task: create a new task in the local mephisto database linked to an existing project
create_mephisto_task_run: create a new task run entry with requester id, provider type, and init params
create_mephisto_agent: create a new agent assigned to a unit with worker id and task run id
create_mephisto_unit: create a new unit within an assignment with pay amount and unit index
